# hecate.demo.add

Adds two integers.

The sum wraps around like any Lua integer.

## Syntax

```lua
---@param a integer
---@param b integer
---@return integer sum
function demo.add(a, b) end
```

## Parameters and return values

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `a` | `integer` | the first addend |
| `b` | `integer` | the second addend |

### Return values

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sum` | `integer` | the sum of the addends |

## Errors raised

Raises [`hecate.demo.CounterError`](../CounterError.md) when `a` or `b` is not an integer.

## May suspend

Does not suspend.

## Examples

```lua
-- Adds two integers.
local demo = require("hecate.demo")

print(demo.add(1, 2))
-- Prints: 3
```

Source: `packages/demo/examples/hecate.demo.add.lua`, run by the tests of the package.

## Specifications and standards

None.

## Compatibility

Introduced in hecate 0.2. Lua 5.5.
